# Vedant Shukla

> Vedant Shukla is a backend and blockchain developer building low-latency Rust and Solana systems, real-time indexers, and distributed infrastructure. He has scaled backends to 35,000 requests per second and works across the stack with Next.js and TypeScript.

## About

- Based in India; works remotely.
- Focus: Rust, Solana, Web3 infrastructure, low-latency backend design, distributed systems.
- Tools: Rust, Axum, Tokio, SQLx, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, Docker, AWS, Next.js, TypeScript.
- Writes about matching engines, cross-chain indexing, Solana programs, and performance.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://vedantshukla.in/): introduction, selected projects, current work.
- [Writings](https://vedantshukla.in/writings): technical notes on Rust and Solana.
- [Projects](https://projects.vedantshukla.in): separate app with project details.
- [RSS feed](https://vedantshukla.in/feed.xml): posts as RSS.

## Projects

- [lobster](https://projects.vedantshukla.in/lobster): limit order book and matching engine in Rust.
- [bridge-indexer](https://projects.vedantshukla.in/): Solana bridge transaction indexer streaming events into Postgres and Redis.
- [streamex-sdk](https://projects.vedantshukla.in/streamex-sdk): unified real-time crypto market data streams for JavaScript applications.

## Writing

- [Writings](https://vedantshukla.in/writings): technical notes on Rust, Solana, and low-latency systems.
